title: Incredible Hong Kong overhaul & iconic Greek Island approaches! | MSFS Marketplace
description:
The Microsoft Flight Simulator marketplace just rolled out an exciting globe-spanning trio of featured releases for flight simmers looking to expand their visual horizons! Today, we take an honest, in-depth look across the Mediterranean, East Asia, and the Maghreb—ranging from dense neon-lit skyscraper corridors and iconic island approaches to an expansive five-airport regional bundle.

In this structured marketplace breakdown, we dive into the details to evaluate whether these three distinct scenery additions deserve a spot in your virtual flight logs:

✈️ IONIAN ISLAND HOLIDAY GATEWAY (CORFU AIRPORT - LGKR): Situated on the edge of the scenic Halikiopoulou Lagoon near the Ionian Sea, Corfu by Gaya Simulations captures one of Europe’s busiest and most picturesque summer charter destinations. Renowned for its world-famous Kanoni plane-spotting vantage point, this rendition features up-to-date real-world aeronautical layouts, handcrafted terminal buildings, custom landside and airside infrastructure, detailed animated airport service vehicles, lagoon watercraft, and authentic seasonal night lighting.

✈️ HANDCRAFTED METROPOLITAN SKYLINE (HONG KONG CITY 2026): Renowned city-builder SamScene3D returns with a sweeping modern overhaul of Hong Kong’s iconic urban core. Packing over 500 handcrafted custom PBR buildings—including modern commercial high-rises, residential districts, banks, and museums—this scenery revitalizes Victoria Harbour with custom bridges, animated Star Ferry vessels, dramatic night illumination, and the modern Kai Tak redevelopment area (note: vintage Kai Tak airport itself is not included).

✈️ REGIONAL VALUE MULTI-PACK (NORTH AFRICA 5-AIRPORT BUNDLE): Developed by Fly & Drive 4D, this regional pack expands coverage across Morocco, Algeria, and Tunisia. Covering Agadir–Al Massira (GMAD), Oran Ahmed Ben Bella (DAOO), Djerba–Zarzis (DTTJ), and Enfidha-Hammamet (DTNH), this collection provides custom 3D terminal models, control towers, accurate ground markings, and sloped runway profiles tailored for budget-minded regional holiday flying.

Will you be shooting the low overwater approach into Corfu, weaving past the towering high-rises of Victoria Harbour, or hopping across North Africa? Let me know in the comments below!

If this structured marketplace breakdown helped you decide on your next scenery purchase, make sure to hit that like button and subscribe for weekly MSFS realism, scenery reviews, and marketplace updates!
